_note: 學習路徑內容建置第7批 #5／6：與過去事實相反的假設 past unreal conditional（eng.t_adv.subj.past-unreal，學測級／高階）。If ＋ had ＋ 過去分詞, 主句 would/could/might have ＋ 過去分詞；描述與過去事實相反、當時沒發生的事。高階特別防第二正解：以 if 子句時態（had p.p.）或主句情態鎖唯一正解，並明確區分『與現在相反（If + 過去式, would + 原形）』和『與過去相反（If + 過去完成式, would have + 過去分詞）』；對比題刻意移除可通的 mixed-conditional 選項、改放 would have 進 if 子句的錯誤形式當誘答。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核（每選項代入 stem 驗唯一正解、play-through 朗讀）。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix sjpa_）。

units.title_zh: 與過去事實相反的假設（If + had p.p., would have p.p.）
units.can_do: 我能用「If ＋ had ＋ 過去分詞, 主句 would／could／might have ＋ 過去分詞」表達與過去事實相反、當時沒有發生的假設，並能分辨與現在相反（If ＋ 過去式, would ＋ 原形）和與過去相反（If ＋ 過去完成式, would have ＋ 過去分詞）。
units.situation_group: 假設語氣 The past unreal conditional
units.subject: eng

claims.text: For something contrary to a PAST fact, use 'If + had + past participle, ... would/could/might have + past participle': If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
claims.verification_ref: 與過去相反＝If ＋ had p.p., would have p.p.；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The if-clause uses the past perfect (had + past participle); do not put 'would' in the if-clause: If she had seen the sign... (not 'If she would have seen').
claims.verification_ref: if 子句用過去完成式 had p.p.，would 不進 if 子句；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The main clause can use 'would have', 'could have', or 'might have' + past participle: If we had left earlier, we could have caught the train.
claims.verification_ref: 主句可用 would/could/might have ＋ 過去分詞；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The past unreal conditional describes a past situation that did NOT happen: 'If I had known' means 'I did not know'.
claims.verification_ref: 過去假設＝與過去事實相反、當時沒發生；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Present unreal = 'If + past simple, would + base' (about now); past unreal = 'If + past perfect, would have + past participle' (about the past).
claims.verification_ref: 區分與現在相反（過去式, would 原形）vs 與過去相反（過去完成式, would have p.p.）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 要講「與過去事實相反、當時其實沒發生」的想像，用：If ＋ had ＋ 過去分詞, 主句 would have ＋ 過去分詞。If I had known 代表「我當時其實不知道」。
If I had set an alarm, I would not have missed the bus.
teach.zh_hint: 如果我當時有設鬧鐘，就不會錯過公車了。其實我沒設、所以錯過了——與過去相反。

teach.body: 分清楚兩種假設：與「現在」相反用 If ＋ 過去式, would ＋ 原形；與「過去」相反用 If ＋ 過去完成式（had p.p.）, would have ＋ 過去分詞。時間點不同，形式不同。
If I were rich, I would buy a big house.
teach.zh_hint: 與現在相反）　If I had been rich back then, I would have bought that house.（與過去相反

teach.body: 主句除了 would have，也可以用 could have（當時就能）或 might have（當時可能會）。注意 would 不放進 if 子句（×If I would have known）。
If they had left earlier, they could have avoided the traffic and might have arrived on time.
teach.zh_hint: 如果他們早點出發，就能避開車潮，可能也會準時到。could have／might have。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：If I had studied harder, I ____ passed the exam.（如果我當時更用功，就會通過考試了——其實我沒有，所以沒通過）

distractor_rationales.would: if 子句用了過去完成式 had studied（與過去相反），主句要用 would have ＋ 過去分詞，不是 would ＋ 原形（那是與現在相反的形式）。
distractor_rationales.will have: will 不用在與事實相反的假設；與過去相反的主句用 would have。
distractor_rationales.had: had passed 是過去完成式，用在 if 子句；主句要用 would have passed。

practice.feedback: 與過去相反：if 子句 had studied → 主句 would have ＋ 過去分詞：I would have passed the exam。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式：If she ____ the warning sign, the accident would not have happened.（如果她當時有看到警告標誌，意外就不會發生了）

distractor_rationales.saw: 主句是 would not have happened（與過去相反），if 子句要用過去完成式 had seen，不是過去簡單式 saw（那搭配與現在相反）。
distractor_rationales.has seen: has seen 是現在完成式，不用在與過去相反的 if 子句；用過去完成式 had seen。
distractor_rationales.would have seen: would 不放進 if 子句（×If she would have seen）；if 子句用 had seen。

practice.feedback: 與過去相反的 if 子句用過去完成式：If she had seen the warning sign, the accident would not have happened。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：If we had left earlier, we ____ caught the train.（如果我們當時早點出發，就能趕上火車了）

distractor_rationales.can have: can 不用在與過去相反的假設；表達「當時就能」用 could have ＋ 過去分詞。
distractor_rationales.could: if 子句用過去完成式 had left（與過去相反），主句要用 could have ＋ 過去分詞，不是 could ＋ 原形。
distractor_rationales.had: had caught 是過去完成式，用在 if 子句；主句表達「當時就能趕上」用 could have caught。

practice.feedback: 與過去相反的主句可用 could have ＋ 過去分詞：we could have caught the train。

practice.stem: 選出正確表達「與過去事實相反（事情當時沒發生）」的假設句：
practice.answer: If he had taken the medicine, he would have felt better.
options: If he had taken the medicine, he would have felt better.
If he took the medicine, he would feel better.
If he takes the medicine, he will feel better.
If he would have taken the medicine, he would have felt better.

distractor_rationales.If he took the medicine, he would feel b: 這是「與現在相反」（If ＋ 過去式, would ＋ 原形），在講現在的假想，不是過去。
distractor_rationales.If he takes the medicine, he will feel b: 這是真實的條件句（If ＋ 現在式, will），講真實又可能的未來，不是與過去相反。
distractor_rationales.If he would have taken the medicine, he: would 不放進 if 子句（×If he would have taken）；正確的 if 子句是 had taken。

practice.feedback: 與過去相反：If ＋ had ＋ 過去分詞, would have ＋ 過去分詞：If he had taken the medicine, he would have felt better。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式：If I ____ your phone number, I would have called you last night.（如果我當時知道你的電話，昨晚就會打給你了）

distractor_rationales.knew: 主句是 would have called you last night（與過去相反），if 子句要用過去完成式 had known，不是過去簡單式 knew。
distractor_rationales.had know: 過去完成式是 had ＋ 過去分詞；know 的過去分詞是 known，不是原形 know（×had know）。
distractor_rationales.would have known: would 不放進 if 子句（×If I would have known）；if 子句用 had known。

practice.feedback: 與過去相反的 if 子句用過去完成式：If I had known your phone number, I would have called you last night。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: If we had known about the storm, we would have stayed at home that day.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：had known（if 子句過去完成式）和 would have stayed（主句 would have ＋ 過去分詞）有沒有用對，about the storm／that day 有沒有漏，逗號和句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。had／have 常輕讀弱化，過去分詞稍清楚；if 子句句尾略停再接主句，句尾下收。

lines.text: If I had studied medicine, I would have become a doctor.
lines.intonation: if 子句後略停、would have become 稍強調、句尾下收

lines.text: If she had asked me, I could have helped her.
lines.intonation: had asked 輕讀、could have helped 稍強調、句尾下收
